description: Mark iCloud Mail messages read or unread, and flag or unflag them, by uid (1–100 uids from apple_mail_search, one mailbox). Only messages not already in the requested state are changed; the result is re-read to verify and lists each message's state and any uids that were not found. Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (app-specific password), and ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS unless the Apple ID is an @icloud.com/@me.com/@mac.com address.

mailbox.description: Mailbox holding the messages (default inbox); path or alias.

seen.description: true = mark read, false = mark unread.

uidValidity.description: The mailbox uidValidity returned alongside the uids. When given, the call is refused if the mailbox was renumbered since (an old uid could then name a different message).

uids.description: Message UIDs from apple_mail_search, all in the same mailbox (1–100).

name: apple_mail_update_flags
title: Mark iCloud Mail read/unread or flagged
